name: MediStock
description: An easy-to-use reservation tool for Sunrise's Multi Media Team to manage and book equipment efficiently.

name: SalesChamp
description: A simple points-tracking dashboard for Sunrise sales agents to view and track their performance in real time.

name: Handsign Translator
description: In this project, I explored computer vision and AI by building a real-time application that translates hand gestures into text. I trained the machine learning model myself to recognize different signs and used hand tracking to detect gestures from a webcam feed.

name: Raspberry Pi Camera (Motion Detection)
description: In my free time, I enjoy building projects with my Raspberry Pi 4. In this project, I connected a camera and a motion sensor to the Raspberry Pi. When movement is detected, the camera takes a photo and sends it to me via Telegram using a bot. I also added a VPN connection to access the Raspberry Pi remotely with OpenVPN.

name: Network Monitoring with InfluxDB & Grafana
description: This project monitors the status of multiple PCs listed in a .txt file. A Bash script pings each PC to check if it's online, then uses Telnet to verify if port 3389 is open. The results are saved in an InfluxDB database and visualized in real-time using a Grafana dashboard. The script runs every minute via cron, providing up-to-date visibility of the network status.
